verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only UI and chat features (Office app integrations, connectors, Browse with Copilot, Cowork) and never mentions a public API. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a programmatic surface, let alone parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
